subject.title: fix: discord exec approvals fails against local self-signed TLS gateway

question: Should maintainers repair/review https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/80204 as the shared bootstrap TLS fingerprint fix, or replace it with a clean equivalent?
rationale: The remaining fix changes certificate fingerprint trust routing across Gateway bootstrap clients, and the active PR is conflicting, so maintainer-owned security-boundary review is needed before merge.

options.title: Repair and review active PR
options.body: Resolve the conflict/import drift in the open shared-bootstrap PR and validate local, remote, CLI, env, fallback, and non-WSS TLS semantics before merge.

options.title: Replace with clean successor
options.body: Open a narrow replacement if the active branch is not worth reconciling, preserving the same shared-bootstrap fix intent and tests.

options.title: Hold for TLS policy redesign
options.body: Keep this issue open without landing until maintainers revisit Gateway TLS pin precedence as a broader policy decision.

recommendation.title: Repair and review active PR
